behavior: Show masked card ID, balance, status and recent activity. Create, rename, select, freeze and unfreeze demo cards.
acceptance: At least three demo cards can be managed. Switching updates the Dashboard; freeze changes require confirmation.

behavior: Choose a fixed or custom positive amount, review and confirm a demo top-up, then show a receipt.
acceptance: The selected balance and a top-up record update together. Receipt shows amount, timestamp and resulting balance.

behavior: Choose a seeded merchant, enter an amount, review the selected card and confirm a simulated payment.
acceptance: Invalid amounts, frozen cards and insufficient balances are rejected. Successful payments produce a receipt and matching debit.

behavior: Browse records; filter by card, category, date range and type; search merchant names and open details.
acceptance: The result list matches all active filters and the search query. Details match the selected stored transaction.

behavior: Show monthly spending totals and a category chart drawn with a custom Android View and Canvas.
acceptance: Totals and chart values agree with the applicable payment records. Top-ups are excluded from spending.

behavior: Store cards and records locally. Commit balance changes and all related ledger records as one database transaction.
acceptance: Data survives restart. A rejected, cancelled or failed operation leaves both the balance and transaction history unchanged.

behavior: Retain relevant form and filter state across rotation. Provide loading, empty, error and success states.
acceptance: Core workflows remain usable after rotation. Empty lists and invalid inputs show clear feedback without losing valid input.

behavior: Configure an enable switch, threshold and reload amount. After an affordable payment, stage one reload if the remaining balance is low.
acceptance: At most one reload occurs per payment. Reload, payment and final balance commit together; an initially unaffordable payment is rejected.

behavior: After a successful payment, alert when the final balance is below the selected threshold. Maintain an in-app message list.
acceptance: The alert reflects the committed balance and user preferences. If OS notifications are unavailable, the in-app message remains accessible.

behavior: Schedule deferrable reminders and demo content refresh. Include expiry reminders when pass or reward features are implemented.
acceptance: Persistent work respects preferences. Any alarm is inexact; the app promises no exact delivery time. Refresh failure leaves local data usable.

behavior: Show seeded locations in map and list views with type filters, details, approximate distance and an external map intent.
acceptance: Approximate location is supported. Denial offers manual district selection. Locations are labelled as demo data; core wallet tasks still work.

behavior: Configure theme, default card, low-balance threshold, reminder preferences and balance visibility.
acceptance: Saved preferences survive restart and update the relevant screens and reminder behavior.

behavior: Scan an app-defined merchant QR code to populate the merchant and demo amount, then review before payment.
acceptance: Scanning never pays automatically. Invalid codes show feedback; manual merchant and amount entry remain available.

behavior: Share a text receipt through an Android share intent.
acceptance: Shared text matches the stored transaction and clearly describes a simulated payment or top-up.

behavior: Buy a simulated monthly pass with demo balance; show validity, transport spending, fictional subsidy rules and claim history.
acceptance: Pass payment follows the same transaction rules. Expiry is visible; subsidy results are clearly fictional and do not imply official entitlement.

behavior: Browse seeded offers, view details and expiry, save favorites and redeem a simulated coupon.
acceptance: Offer state persists locally. A coupon cannot be redeemed twice; every offer and redemption remains labelled as demo content.

behavior: Display the selected demo card with user-controlled balance visibility and a shortcut to the Dashboard.
acceptance: The widget reflects the selected card and stored balance. Hiding the balance prevents its display outside the app.

behavior: Optionally shake to hide or reveal the balance only while the Dashboard is visible; provide the same on-screen control.
acceptance: No gesture triggers a payment. Missing sensors do not block use, and listeners stop when the Dashboard leaves its active lifecycle.
